title: Lead capture to CRM with a welcome email
summary: A new lead from a form is checked, saved to your CRM table once per email address, and sent a short welcome email.

requirements.purpose: The CRM table that receives each lead (a leads table with name, email and company columns, unique on email).
A form or webhook that delivers {name, email, company}.

success_criteria: A lead with a name and a well-formed email address is saved once, with the submitted name, email and company, and is sent one welcome email at the submitted address.
A lead with a malformed email address or no name is rejected: nothing is saved and no email is sent.
The welcome email promises nothing specific: no prices, dates or offers.

config.prompt: A new lead was submitted through a form; the submission is the upstream output. Personal details reach you as placeholders such as <PERSON>, <EMAIL_ADDRESS>, <PHONE_NUMBER>, <DATE_TIME>, <LOCATION> or <URL>: the system replaces each detected detail with one before you see it. Treat a placeholder as a value that is present, never try to reconstruct it, and do not repeat personal details in anything you write. Accept the lead only when it has a name and a well-formed email address (an email the system recognised appears as <EMAIL_ADDRESS>; text that is not a well-formed address stays as written). If it is accepted, also write a short, friendly welcome email that greets the reader without using their name and promises nothing specific (no prices, dates or offers). Respond with {"valid": true or false, "reason": one sentence naming what was checked or what was wrong, "welcome": null when not valid, otherwise {"subject": a subject line, "body": plain text under 120 words}}.

success_criteria: valid is false, with the reason, when the email address is malformed or the name is missing, and true otherwise.
When valid, the welcome email promises no prices, dates or offers; when not valid, welcome is null.

arguments.statement: INSERT INTO leads (name, email, company) VALUES ($1, lower($2), $3) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, company = EXCLUDED.company

test_cases.name: valid lead is saved and welcomed
success_criteria: It is saved with the submitted name, email and company, and a welcome email goes to the submitted email address.
The welcome email is a generic acknowledgement with no commercial or scheduling commitments (prices, dates or offers).

test_cases.name: malformed email is rejected
success_criteria: The lead is rejected because the email address is malformed.
Nothing is saved and no welcome email is sent.
